author: ThioJoe
description:
No company is safe anymore, they even got Microsoft

A whopping 73 different official Microsoft GitHub repositories were hacked and used to host malicious code for several hours before it was discovered. The craziest part is they were initially compromised by the same exact account that was hacked a few weeks ago, so they didn't secure it properly. Then once the hackers got the foot in the door, other employees were compromised which allowed the worm to spread.
